purpose: Cross-fitted residual calibration using frozen-base logits beyond the initial-state transition prior
prompt: Exactly the frozen classifier-v1 messages/token mapping; initial-only profiles
fold_assignment: Frozen metadata-only connected topic/person components in folds-v3.json; all92 held out exactlyonce
prior: Laplace-one six-by-six transition table fitted on the fitting portion of each fold only
objective: Equal-group mean normalized six-category RPS +0.01mean(b^2) +0.01alpha^2 for extension; control has same bias penalty
oof_gate: Complete finite paired coverage and allfits successful. Extension improves equal-group OOF RPS over BOTH calibrated control and unadjusted fold transition by at least0.01; no heldout component worsens by morethan0.05 against EITHER comparator.
internal_gate: Only after OOFpass: refit both once onall92, predict existing exposed24 from sealed base logits, seal coefficients/predictions/evaluator beforetargetaccess. Retain direction of improvement overbothcomparators; report allcomponents. No automaticoutervalidation.
failure_policy: Failclosed on nonfinite data/objective/gradient/predictions, convergencefailure, resource or integritymismatch. No retries, grid, alternate initializations, repairs or truncation.
interpretation: Development calibration diagnostic. Logits include initialcategory/topic/explanation together; any incremental gain is not isolated causaltextvalue. Conditional answer probabilities are not measured latentbeliefs.
data_boundaries: Predictor reads prepared initialprofiles/prompts only; no fitlabels, candidateadapter, internal24targets, outervalidation orreserve. Solver receives fittingfoldlabels only. Internaloutcomes are gated byOOF success and predictionseal.
